description: This file defines the business logic for managing defects and root cause analysis (RCA) within a manufacturing defect management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating defects, and handling RCA data, with embedded business rules such as RCA gating for critical defects.

classes.name: DefectsService
classes.description: Business logic class for defects and RCA management, implementing creation, retrieval, updating, and RCA handling with embedded business rules.

methods.name: list[dict] list_defects(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all defects with their object IDs serialized.

methods.name: dict create_defect(self, payload: dict, created_by: dict)
methods.description: Creates a new defect record with given payload and creator info, returns the created defect.

methods.name: dict get_defect(self, defect_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a defect by its ID, returning its details or aborting if not found or invalid.

methods.name: dict update_defect(self, defect_id: str, payload: dict)
methods.description: Updates an existing defect, enforcing business rules such as RCA presence for critical status changes.

methods.name: dict get_rca(self, defect_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves RCA data associated with a defect, returning null if none exists.

methods.name: dict upsert_rca(self, defect_id: str, payload: dict, updated_by: dict)
methods.description: Creates or updates RCA data for a defect, ensuring defect existence.

ctags.name: create_defect
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_defect(self, payload: dict, created_by: dict) -> dict:$/

ctags.name: update_defect
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_defect(self, defect_id: str, payload: dict) -> dict:$/

ctags.name: upsert_rca
ctags.pattern: /^    def upsert_rca(self, defect_id: str, payload: dict, updated_by: dict) -> dict:$/
ctags.signature: (self, defect_id: str, payload: dict, updated_by: dict)
